why: `Cx < Dy` and `Dy < Cx`: a class cannot be its own superclass, however far up, and MATLAB defines neither (it refuses a circular class definition), so no method is inherited along the circle. `spin(x)` in the class folder file `@Cx/f.m` is no call of `Dy::spin`, not even by the caller-class guess (project rule, step 15 item 7: never inherit along a circular chain).
